name: Scale Stack
author: Tom Burns
description: Five voices spaced an equal number of scale degrees apart, sweeping from cluster to wide chord without ever leaving the scale. From Tom Burns' Braids Renaissance firmware.

controls.label: Span
controls.description: Sets the spacing between voices, from one scale degree up to sixteen.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Detunes the voices against each other and folds them where the waveform is still near sine.

controls.label: Waveform
controls.description: Morphs every voice from sine through triangle and saw to square.

controls.label: Scale
controls.description: Selects the scale the stack is quantized to, which is what the spacing counts in.

outputs.main: Five-voice scale stack; the stereo toggle does not change this fixed MAIN/AUX pair.
outputs.aux: Root voice; the stereo toggle does not change this fixed MAIN/AUX pair.

trigger: Realigns every voice so a struck stack starts the same way each time.
